basic_info.description: Experience elevated urban living in this exceptional 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence perched on the 15th floor of The Arden. This rarely available unit offers panoramic views of Mission Creek, the city skyline, and iconic landmarks like the Bay Bridge, Sales Force Tower and Oracle Park through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows.The open-concept layout features a gourmet kitchen equipped with premium Thermador appliances, Caesarstone countertops, and a spacious island ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite serves as a tranquil retreat with dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate glass-enclosed shower. The second bedroom provides flexibility for guests, a home office, or a personal gym.  There is a second full bath ideal for guests, with a shower over the tub. Additional highlights include hardwood flooring in the living areas, and carries on through the bedrooms. This exceptional unit offers central air conditioning, a full-sized washer and dryer, and a private terrace perfect for enjoying the city's vibrant atmosphere.    The unit also comes with one assigned parking space equipped and a dedicated storage unit.
